messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0026. Outcome: refund_full $6.61. Recommended action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and send the driver's "I'm Here" tap at 601 m for account review + flag_account. Escalated: False.
Reasoning:
The driver cancelled and claimed the rider was a no-show, so the fee stands only if NS-1's three conditions all hold [F3][F12][NS-0]. They do not. NS-1(i) is satisfied on the record (the "I'm Here" tap at 12:05:55) [F5], but NS-1(ii) fails: the system shows the driver 601 m from the pickup at the moment of the tap and a closest approach of only 545 m, never entering the 200 m arrival radius [F5][F1][NS-1]. NS-1(iii) also fails: the driver was stationary 12:05:35–12:09:05 about 600 m from the pickup and spent 0 s inside the radius after tapping [F2][F5][NS-1]. The platform never recorded arrival at the pickup point [F4], and the rider's own message at 12:06 says she was at the pickup point and saw no car, which the drivers' later "waited more than 3 min, cancelling" does not answer [F9][F10]. With NS-1(ii) and (iii) both failing, NS-2 makes the $6.61 cancellation fee refundable in full; the amount is the recorded fee, $6.61 [F6][NS-2]. Because the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS puts him well outside the pickup area, NS-2's second limb also calls for flagging the account for the fake-arrival tap, and RD-6 is not needed for that [F5][F1][NS-2]. Nothing in the record supports any traffic or route justification, and weather is fair [F13][F14][F15]. The rider's and driver's history is clean, but profile facts never decide a case on their own; they merely confirm no aggravating pattern [F16][F17].

function.name: final_result
function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments:
{"rider": "You're getting a full refund of the $6.61 cancellation fee, paid as a Ryde voucher on your account.

Two things decided this. The driver tapped "I'm Here" while still about 600 metres from the pickup point and never came within the arrival zone — the closest he got was roughly 545 metres. He also didn't wait inside that zone at all before cancelling. So the fee shouldn't have been charged.

Nothing else is needed from you. If you have questions about the voucher, contact support.", "driver": "Your cancellation fee claim was not upheld, so the rider is being refunded $6.61 as a Ryde voucher.

Two facts decided it. Your "I'm Here" tap was recorded while your location was about 601 metres from the pickup point, and you never entered the arrival zone — closest approach was roughly 545 metres, with no time spent inside it. The platform also never logged an arrival at the pickup point.

Separately, your account is being flagged for review because the "I'm Here" tap registered well outside the pickup area. We'll look at your arrival taps and trip records. No action is needed from you now — just keep tapping "I'm Here" only once you're actually at the pickup point."}
